hints.title: Base Subsequence Tally
hints.text: Count existing pairs of pattern characters matching order using a running count of the leading pattern character.

hints.title: Optimal Insertion Positions
hints.text: Inserting pattern[0] at the front pairs with every existing pattern[1]; inserting pattern[1] at the back pairs with every pattern[0].

hints.title: Max Additional Yield
hints.text: Add the maximum of total pattern[0] count or total pattern[1] count to the base total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass accumulating prefix character occurrences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible insertion indices leads to O(N^2) complexity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that extreme ends are optimal insertion points.
